pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.html:
Draft updated 24 September 2026.

Who this policy covers

This policy describes how PDFBlueprints handles information relating to this website, purchases and customer support. Contact support@pdfblueprints.store with privacy questions.

Information we use

When you buy a guide, checkout and delivery providers process your email address, product selection, order and payment status, and any billing information required for payment and tax. When you email us, we receive your email address and the information you choose to send.

Our hosting provider processes technical information such as IP addresses, browser information and request logs to deliver and secure the website. The custom storefront does not currently use advertising pixels or optional analytics cookies. External checkout services have their own cookies and privacy notices.

Why we use it

  • To fulfil purchases, provide downloads and answer order enquiries: performance of our contract with you.
  • To keep the website secure, investigate errors and manage customer support: our legitimate interests in operating the store.
  • To maintain records required by tax, accounting or other applicable law: legal obligations.
  • To send optional marketing where you have agreed: your consent, which you can withdraw.

Service providers

Cloudflare hosts the storefront. Payhip handles checkout, order records and digital delivery. Stripe and PayPal process payments when selected. Zoho provides our domain email service. We do not receive your complete payment-card number through this storefront.

These providers may process information in other countries under their applicable data protection arrangements. Their notices explain their processing and safeguards: Cloudflare, Payhip, Stripe, PayPal and Zoho.

Existing orders

Records of purchases made through our previous Shopify store may remain in our historical order records while needed for support, accounting and legal obligations. New purchases use Payhip.

Retention and your choices

We keep information for as long as needed for the purposes above, including applicable recordkeeping requirements. Contact us to ask about your records or request deletion where applicable.

Depending on your circumstances, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your personal data, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You can withdraw marketing consent without affecting earlier lawful processing. You can also complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office or your local supervisory authority.

pages.title: Refunds and download support
pages.html:
Help with a download

If a download is missing, damaged, inaccessible or different from its description, contact support@pdfblueprints.store with your order reference and a description of the problem. We will investigate and arrange the appropriate remedy.

Your rights

Nothing in this policy limits your statutory consumer rights. Digital content must meet the standards required by applicable law. A refund, replacement or other remedy may be available where those standards are not met.

Cancellation

Where a cooling-off right applies to digital content, it is not lost simply because a product is described as a download. Immediate supply and the loss of a cancellation right require the consent and acknowledgement required by applicable law. If you wish to cancel, contact us promptly with your order reference.

Refund processing

Approved refunds are handled through the payment method used for the order. Your payment provider determines when the refunded amount appears in your account.

pages.title: Digital delivery
pages.html:
These products are digital PDF downloads. No physical item is shipped and there is no delivery charge.

After successful Payhip checkout, your download page contains the purchased files. Payhip also emails a receipt with a download link. Packs contain the files described on the product page.

You need an internet connection to download your files and a PDF reader to open them. Save a copy on your device. Check your spam folder if a receipt does not arrive, or contact support@pdfblueprints.store with your order reference.

For older purchases from Shopify, contact us if your original download link no longer works.

pages.title: Store terms
pages.html:
Our products

PDFBlueprints sells downloadable guides and workbooks. Check the product description, edition, file information and sample pages before purchasing. Products are general educational information and do not replace professional advice suited to your circumstances.

Ordering and payment

Purchase buttons take you to Payhip. Review the product, currency, applicable taxes and final total shown before confirming payment. Stripe or PayPal processes your payment when selected. A successful order provides the files described on the product page.

Using your purchase

Unless a product states different licence terms, a purchase is for your own personal use or internal use in your own business. You may save and print a copy for that use. You may not resell, redistribute or publicly share the files or use them to create a competing product without permission. Copyright remains with its owner.

Accuracy and updates

Rules, fees and other information can change after a guide is published. Check current official sources before acting on time-sensitive information. A purchase does not include a promise of future editions unless expressly stated in the product description.

Problems and consumer rights

Read our refund and download support policy. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits rights or liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

Privacy and contact

Our privacy policy explains how we handle personal information. For questions about an order or these terms, email support@pdfblueprints.store.
